title: netSoldier Enforcement Action
description: A killswitch enforcement decision and its lifecycle, as returned by the killswitch-controller API. Version 2.x. Mirrors events.EnforcementAction in libs/events; libs/events/schema_test.go fails when the two drift apart.

id.description: Action id, namespaced per controller process.

detection_id.description: Id of the detection event that triggered the action.

detection_summary.description: Copy of the detection's summary, for the approval dialog. Display only.

client_name.description: Device name from the detection, if known.

state.description: pending: awaiting a human. approved: approved, the driver has not confirmed yet. active: enforced. apply_failed: the driver failed to apply and nothing is enforced (terminal). revert_failed: the driver failed to lift it and it is STILL enforced; the controller keeps retrying. reverted, rejected, expired (pending and never approved in time): terminal.

target_mac.description: MAC of the device the action is about.

target_ip.description: IP of the device the action is about.

blocked_domain.description: The domain a dns_sinkhole blocks. Taken from a domain target only.

policy_rule.description: Why the policy decided what it did; for a pending action, why it could not be enforced automatically.

activated_at.description: When the driver confirmed the apply.

expires_at.description: activated_at + ttl_seconds; absent until the action is active.

reverted_by.description: Actor of the revert; 'ttl' for the reaper.

failure_reason.description: Which driver call failed and why.
